options.name: add_to_pgs
options.description: A new volume will be added to the specified protection groups on creation

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: bw_qos
options.description: Bandwidth limit for volume in M or G units. M will set MB/s G will set GB/s To clear an existing QoS setting use 0 (zero)

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: count
options.description: Number of volumes to be created in a multiple volume creation Only supported from Purity//FA v6.0.0 and higher

options.name: digits
options.description: Number of digits to use for multiple volume count. This will pad the index number with zeros where necessary Only supported from Purity//FA v6.0.0 and higher Range is between 1 and 10

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: eradicate
options.description: Define whether to eradicate the volume on delete or leave in trash.

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: iops_qos
options.description: IOPs limit for volume - use value or K or M K will mean 1000 M will mean 1000000 To clear an existing IOPs setting use 0 (zero)

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: move
options.description: Move a volume in and out of a pod or vgroup Provide the name of pod or vgroup to move the volume to Pod and Vgroup names must be unique in the array To move to the local array, specify C(local) This is not idempotent - use C(ignore_errors) in the play

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the volume. Volume could be created in a POD with this syntax POD_NAME::VOLUME_NAME. Volume could be created in a volume group with this syntax VG_NAME/VOLUME_NAME. Multi-volume support available from Purity//FA 6.0.0 B(***NOTE***) Manual deletion or eradication of individual volumes created using multi-volume will cause idempotency to fail Multi-volume support only exists for volume creation

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Define whether to overwrite a target volume if it already exists.

options.name: pgroup
options.description: Name of existing, not deleted, protection group to add volume to Only application for volume(s) creation Superseded from Purity//FA 6.3.4 by I(add_to_pgs)

options.name: priority_operator
options.description: DMM Priority Adjustment operator

options.name: priority_value
options.description: DMM Priority Adjustment value

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: promotion_state
options.description: Promote or demote the volume so that the volume starts or stops accepting write requests.

options.name: rename
options.description: Value to rename the specified volume to. Rename only applies to the container the current volumes is in. There is no requirement to specify the pod or vgroup name as this is implied.

options.name: size
options.description: Volume size in M, G, T or P units.

options.name: start
options.description: Number at which to start the multiple volume creation index Only supported from Purity//FA v6.0.0 and higher

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the volume should exist or not.

options.name: suffix
options.description: Suffix string, if required, for multiple volume create Volume names will be formed as I(<name>#I<suffix>), where I(#) is a placeholder for the volume index See associated descriptions Only supported from Purity//FA v6.0.0 and higher

options.name: target
options.description: The name of the target volume, if copying.

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: with_default_protection
options.description: Whether to add the default container protection groups to those specified in I(add_to_pgs) as the initial protection of a new volume.
